name: BambooHR
summary: BambooHR is a full HR system whose time-off module comes with every plan, at $10, $17 or $25 per employee a month. Companies with 25 or fewer employees pay flat monthly minimums of $250, $425 or $650 instead. That makes it a poor fit for a small team that only wants leave tracking.

facts.text: The pricing page headlines $10, $17 and $25 per employee a month for Core, Pro and Elite, while its FAQ says $10.25 and $17.50 for Core and Pro. We list the headline figures and flag the difference.
Companies with 25 or fewer employees pay a flat $250, $425 or $650 a month for Core, Pro or Elite. Volume discounts apply by headcount, and nonprofits get a further 15% off.
Time-off management on Core covers requests, accruals and approvals, a time-off calendar showing who is out, and unlimited custom policies.
The BambooHR site states an annual third-party SOC II audit and lists SAML support among its security measures. Its data center in Ireland is described as meeting European Union data requirements.

hiddenCosts: Companies with 25 or fewer employees pay a flat monthly minimum of $250, $425 or $650, so a team of 8 on Core pays $250, not $80.
The headline per-employee prices for Core and Pro differ from the FAQ figures of $10.25 and $17.50.
The 15% bundle discount for Payroll and Benefits Administration applies only to US-based employees.

contract.cancellation: The pricing FAQ offers flexible month-to-month terms or an extended term; the length and conditions of the extended term are not stated.
